# kubesense Provider

Manage KubeSense dashboards and integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    kubesense = {
      source = "kubesense-ai/kubesense"
    }
  }
}

# api_url and api_key can come from KUBESENSE_API_URL and KUBESENSE_API_KEY.
provider "kubesense" {
  api_url = "https://kubesense.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Service-account API key. Defaults to the KUBESENSE_API_KEY environment variable.
- `api_url` (String) Base URL of the KubeSense deployment, e.g. https://kubesense.example.com. Defaults to the KUBESENSE_API_URL environment variable.
